construction, support and limitations
share of team attempts: focal/neutral probabilities and percentage-point difference in a 3F/2D unit;
seven-state skill, exact-state qualifying minutes. not observed share or finishing.
ordinary-minor distributions show team-award differences. value uses an isolated two-minute approximation;
calibrated uncertainty and optimizer accuracy are unknown.
calibrated player uncertainty is unknown; empirical population spread is not uncertainty.
reference execution: virtual neutral shooter, inferred setter and goalie. complete maps insert one focal
player, not actual deployment.
workload: 1,000 5v5 / 100 pp / 100 pk min. pp/pk use league-time mixtures; specialty time may be hypothetical
or prior-only.
attempt integrals differ from xg insets. positive against is more against; positive taking contrasts are more
penalties.
inferred territory: successor goals per 1,000 5v5 min; positive ice lost is more against. interpolated
movement and terminal-zone proxy; fixed substitution/common survival; uncertainty not estimated.
10ft pooling and contours do not establish fine-scale reliability. aggregate support need not inform every
head.
